# Contributors who get a preview without being made a repository collaborator.
# Only read from the default branch, so a pull request cannot approve itself by
# editing this file.
#
# Removing someone here does not take down a preview that is already deployed;
# see the "Pull request previews" section in the README.
#
# One GitHub username per line, case-insensitive. Lines starting with # are
# ignored.
#
# example-contributor
